trello.name: Wildcard SSL Certificate Renewal and Deployment
trello.desc: Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com, deploy it to the load balancers, and ensure it is set up for auto-renewal using cert-manager. Also, rotate the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh during the same window as the public certificate renewal. Target completion by August 22nd. Responsible: Ben.

trello.name: PDF Export Feature for Reports
trello.desc: Develop the PDF export feature for reports. This includes backend rendering of the report to PDF using headless Chrome and frontend implementation of the export button with a progress state for large reports. Additionally, create a short demo GIF for the changelog once the feature is completed. Target completion by the end of the month. Responsible: Aisha.

trello.name: Staging Environment Parity
trello.desc: Ensure the staging environment is in sync with production by running the three pending migrations. Implement a nightly job to compare the staging schema against production and notify the infra channel if they diverge. Responsible: Ben.
